inspection_commands.stdin:
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
root = Path('.scratch/fresh-authoring-01/pilot-01/packets/r02')
packet = json.loads((root / 'PACKET.json').read_bytes())
selection = json.loads((root / 'return/SELECTION.json').read_bytes())
entries = [(item['path'], item) for item in packet['source']]
entries.append(('return/' + selection['answer']['path'], selection['answer']))
entries.extend(('return/' + item['path'], item) for item in selection['support'] if item['available'])
for relative, expected in entries:
    raw = (root / relative).read_bytes()
    print(json.dumps({'path': relative, 'bytes': len(raw), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(), 'matches_declared_bytes_and_hash': len(raw) == expected['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == expected['sha256']}))
print(json.dumps({'checked_files': len(entries), 'unavailable_support': [item['id'] for item in selection['support'] if not item['available']], 'inspection': 'byte identities only; no subject or authored code executed'}))
